description: First actual isolated_stdio_v1 Docker qualification exposed two concrete compatibility failures: installed Docker CLI emits exact lowercase error: no such object, which strict absence parsing rejected; create --interactive without explicit attach stdin leaves StdinOnce false, so the exact /bin/cat input never received EOF and execution timed out. Source adds only the exact lowercase absence form plus explicit attached stdin/stdout/stderr and actual StdinOnce validation. Original owned container cleanup then blocked in Docker inspect/rm despite healthy daemon info; exact original ownership is retained and no engine restart/foreign state mutation was attempted. Estimated time lost 180 seconds so far; runtime requalification pending.
